notes: Settings > Income sources: name the people behind the paychecks (e.g. Roxann's pay lands in two accounts under two different names) and pick a person for each source seen in the last 12 months. The Income report, the Family review and the Money flow diagram then roll income up per person, with the individual sources folded underneath; clicking a person row opens all of their transactions (the Transactions search now takes 'a | b' to mean either). Money flow: the Investments row now sits directly under Income with its own sources on the left (market gains, dividends, money put in) and outcomes on the right (Kept invested, fees, taken out to the bank); a spending gap is split into 'From investments' (cash actually pulled from the investment accounts) and 'From savings'. Fixes: person rows lined up with the month columns; the Reports tab no longer scrolls sideways on a phone (period buttons wrap, wide tables scroll inside their card).
